def: IEEE 754 half precision: 16 bits with 1 sign, 5 exponent and 10 mantissa bits, more precise than BF16 but with a largest finite value of only 65,504.
practice: Its narrow range makes FP16 training need loss scaling, so BF16 replaced it where hardware allows, though a 2025 study found FP16 reduces training-inference mismatch in RL fine-tuning.
